title: Pharaoh's End, Written Records, and the Most Merciful

paragraphs.text: Warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh, but they denied every one of Allah's signs. So Allah seized them, with the seizure of One who is Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability, and none of them could escape.

The disbelievers being addressed are then asked a direct question. Are they any better than those earlier nations, or have they been given some protection written in the scriptures? Perhaps they say that they are a united group who will support one another. But this group will be defeated, and they will turn their backs and run away. Moreover, the Hour is their real appointment, and the Hour will be far more disastrous and more bitter than any defeat in this world. The criminals are lost in error and madness. On the Day when they are dragged into the Fire on their faces, they will be told to taste the touch of Saqar.

Allah has created everything according to a precise measure and decree. His command is carried out with a single word, as quickly as the blink of an eye. He has already destroyed others like them in the past, so is there anyone who will remember? Everything that people do is kept in written records, and every matter, whether small or great, is recorded. In contrast to the criminals, the righteous will live among gardens and rivers. They will sit in a seat of honor in the presence of a Sovereign who is Perfect in Ability. This is the final picture of the surah: a place of truth, nearness, and great respect for those who were mindful of their Lord.

The following surah begins with one of Allah's beautiful names, the Most Merciful. The first thing mentioned about Him is that He taught the Qur'an, showing that this teaching is itself one of His greatest gifts to people.
